[EN] Atel Akaad brought a shipment in, but a {@LinkCreature:39#200#clawrider overseer} attacked me before the shipment could be intercepted. They're too strong for a mere arcanist.

If could get it out of my way....
[ES] Atel Akaad trajo un cargamento, pero un {@LinkCreature:39#200#clawrider overseer} me atacó antes de que el cargamento pudiera ser interceptado. Son demasiado fuertes para un simple arcanist.

Si pudiera quitarlo de mi camino...

[EN] You have my gratitude, . Many thanks.
[ES] Tienes mi gratitud, . Muchas gracias.
